purpose: Ordinary smarty control: a benign snippet that must keep 1 detector(s) silent.

groundTruth.rationale: The authored snippet is ordinary, idiomatic content with nothing the named detectors describe, so every one of them must stay silent.

limitations: Synthetic benign snippet authored for this case; silence here does not prove silence on every benign file.
